item.name: Default Music
item.obtainment: Unlocked in the music menu when you join the game.
item.cardSummary: The starter restaurant playlist. It is free, always available, and counts toward playing music for atmosphere rating.

item.name: Restaurant Tycoon OST
item.obtainment: Unlocked in the music menu when you join the game.
item.cardSummary: The free official soundtrack disc. The wiki notes it was released on Spotify under the name Cooking Fever.

item.name: Classical
item.obtainment: Buy from the music menu with Diamonds. This main disc stays available after purchase.
item.cardSummary: A Diamond main disc with 6 tracks. Buy it from the music menu whenever you want a classical restaurant playlist.

item.name: Disco
item.obtainment: Buy from the music menu with Diamonds. This main disc stays available after purchase.
item.cardSummary: A Diamond main disc with 10 tracks. It is one of the larger always-available playlists in the music menu.

item.name: Synthwave
item.obtainment: Buy from the music menu with Diamonds. This main disc stays available after purchase.
item.cardSummary: A Diamond main disc with 7 tracks. The official wiki lists it as Synthwave. Older menus and Fandom called the same slot Jazz.

item.name: Lo-Fi
item.obtainment: Buy from the music menu with Diamonds. This main disc stays available after purchase.
item.cardSummary: A Diamond main disc with 10 tracks. Use it when you want a longer always-available lo-fi playlist.

item.name: Lounge
item.obtainment: Buy from the music menu with Diamonds. This main disc stays available after purchase.
item.cardSummary: A Diamond main disc with 4 tracks. It is a smaller always-available playlist next to the free Default Music disc.

item.name: Electronic
item.obtainment: Buy from the music menu with Diamonds. This main disc stays available after purchase.
item.cardSummary: A higher-cost Diamond main disc with 8 tracks. The shop table calls it Electronic. The wiki soundtrack table still labels the same playlist Electrical.

item.name: Tobu
item.obtainment: Buy from the music menu with Diamonds. This main disc stays available after purchase.
item.cardSummary: A higher-cost Diamond main disc with 6 tracks. It is one of the two 25 Diamond always-available playlists.

item.name: Halloween
item.obtainment: Buy from the music menu with Diamonds while the matching Halloween event shop is open.
item.cardSummary: An event music disc with 8 tracks. It was offered during Halloween 2025 and is not a year-round Diamond shop item.

item.name: Christmas Jazz
item.obtainment: Buy from the music menu with Diamonds while the matching Christmas event shop is open.
item.cardSummary: An event music disc with 8 tracks. Ultraw added the Christmas Jazz Music Pack in the December 2025 winter update.

item.name: Tropical
item.obtainment: Buy from the music menu with Diamonds while this event disc is offered.
item.eventWindow: Announced May 15, 2026. Official wiki labeled Now as of July 18, 2026.
item.cardSummary: An event music disc with 9 tracks. Ultraw announced the Tropical Music Pack on May 15, 2026. The official wiki still labeled it Now on July 18, 2026, without a later shop confirmation.

item.name: Classical Ensemble
item.obtainment: Buy from the music menu with Cash. Unlike Diamond discs, this live-music option also shows live bands.
item.cardSummary: The Cash live-music option, with 5 tracks and on-plot live bands. Ultraw added Classical Ensemble in the July 17, 2026 Classical Music Update.
